name: Karver
source:
"I promised I'd always be there for you. Crossing worlds is just part of that promise."

Karver, your childhood friend and first love. The history between the two of you could fill a trilogy; you can never seem to break free from each other. This man, who both saved your heart and broke it, is determined to protect you at all costs. 

Your mark appears on his neck. It’s a symbol that is impossible to hide, much like the connection that you both share. This man who betrayed you. This man who crossed worlds for you. This man who is surrounded by secrets that he refuses to reveal…. Can you trust him?

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/eternallovestudios/shattered-souls-a-dark-fantasy-isekai-otome]Kickstarter[/url]]
